sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Pradeep Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Kiran Kushwaha,Krishna Kumar Singh Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No.52 of 2022,
under Section 498A, 304B I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P.Act, Police Station Saini, District Kaushambi with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is husband of deceased Chitra @
Mohni and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The marriage of applicant was solemnized with the deceased on 10.08.2020 and deceased committed suicide on 01.02.2022 for the reason that she wanted to live with the applicant separately.
No injury, except ligature mark, was present on the person of deceased.
No demand was ever made by the applicant and his family member with the deceased.

It is further submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 05.02.2022 having no criminal history and that in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.

Per-contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant have vehemently opposed the bail application and argued that deceased died during one and half years in the house of applicant Jitendra Kumar Maurya vs State Of U.P. on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75834188/
1 under suspicious circumstance.

entities.text: Jitendra Kumar Maurya vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Cause of death noted Asphyxia as a result of antemortem hanging.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of allegations, gravity of offence, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the opinion that no case for grant of bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby rejected.

It is clarified that the observations, if any, made in this order are strictly confined to the disposal of this bail application and must not be construed to have any reflection on the ultimate merits of the case.
